{{Top|leg}}
'''Air Traffic Control''' was a building in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The computers there determined the traffic lanes in the area of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] offices.<ref name="sc">{{WizCite|story=Shadows of Coruscant|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook}}</ref>

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], criminal organization [[The Flail]] attempted to take over Air Traffic Control and launch a remote-piloted vehicle to collide against the Chancellor's location. The Flail were unable to overcome Air Traffic Control security.<ref name="sc" />
